config.description: Arm configurations for the Bedrock KB anchor benchmark. Committed before any run so the configs are on record. Bedrock is an anchor, not a subject; no sweep.

P-snippet.label: P-snip
P-snippet.note: Same retrieval as P, different excerpt style. Included because excerpt style proved a larger lever than any Bedrock config difference measured here.

P-window.label: P-win
P-window.note: Same retrieval as P; excerpt is a ~600-token contiguous block window around the anchor (keyword hit, best sub-page chunk, or page top). Fewer, larger units at the same token budget.

P-window300.label: P-win300
P-window300.note: Window arm at half the default budget per excerpt (~6 hits fit 2,000 tokens instead of ~3), to separate the unit-shape effect from the coverage cost on spread.

config.revision_rule: An arm id names one immutable index. To change a config, add a new id with a bumped -vN suffix and provision it; never edit an existing id in place. `label` is the short name used in result tables.

excluded.HIERARCHICAL: AWS does not recommend with S3 vector buckets (metadata size limits)
excluded.SEMANTIC: rejects files over 1 MB body text (Arroyo 2026); several corpus docs exceed it
excluded.NONE: Titan v2 caps 8,192 tokens per request; most corpus docs exceed it
excluded.bedrock_data_automation: $0.010/page, ~$22 per corpus; not needed for an anchor
